notes.title: Patch Update
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has played and supported the game so far. I’ve been overwhelmed by the positive reception and helpful feedback. 



This update focuses on balance adjustments based on community feedback, especially around the Valve Puzzle. Here’s what’s new:



Patch Notes

Reduced sanity loss from the Valve Puzzle to make it more forgiving.

Reduced sanity loss from the radio task as it was also excessive.
